tool.name: Biomni: Model Protein Dimerization Network
tool.description: Model protein dimerization networks to find equilibrium concentrations of dimers.

param.name: monomer_concentrations
param.label: Monomer Concentrations
param.help: Dictionary mapping monomer names to their initial concentrations (in arbitrary units)

param.name: dimerization_affinities
param.label: Dimerization Affinities
param.help: Dictionary mapping dimer names (as 'A-B' strings) to their association constants (Ka)

param.name: network_topology
param.label: Network Topology
param.help: List of (monomer1, monomer2) pairs that can form dimers

tool.help:
**Biomni: Model Protein Dimerization Network**
Model protein dimerization networks to find equilibrium concentrations of dimers.
Parameters: ----------- monomer_concentrations : dict Dictionary mapping monomer names to their initial concentrations (in arbitrary units) dimerization_affinities : dict Dictionary mapping dimer names (as 'A-B' strings) to their association constants (Ka) network_topology : list of tuples List of (monomer1, monomer2) pairs that can form dimers
Returns: -------- str Research log summarizing the modeling process and results
**Domain**: systems_biology **Function**: model_protein_dimerization_network
